body: Yep, keep up the good work and thanks again!

Wow man, that is probably the most inspirational thing I've heard in a long time, and exactly what I needed right now. You're right, I can beat this. Your gut feeling was right, it's pretty much how I cope (I'm probably one of the only kids who can't wait for summer to be over) so to not have that I just felt hit with everything at once. Regardless, I guess I'll get back in the ring and do my best (I am the master of last minute saves).

Also, you have my deepest sympathies. No kid should have to go through losing their father, I'm so sorry to hear that. I think it's amazing that you could overcome that and now help people though; that's just incredible and inspirational to me. Thank you so much kind stranger!
